android.desc:
Designed for investors, by investors, Trelly has just what you need to find, assess and buy investment property from wherever you’re working.
 
Realtime Inventory
Sign up today to check out exclusive, off-market investment properties – even before they’re listed for foreclosure or on the MLS. Explore new properties you can’t find anywhere else, listed by wholesalers and investors you can trust. Filter by location, price, year built, and other property stats. See photos, comps and disclosures that help you analyze property condition, especially for distressed inventory.
 
First Strike
The market for rental properties, flips, wholesale and wholetail opportunities is hot, so you need to move quickly. Save your searches to be sure you don’t miss out. When a new property meets your buying criteria, you’ll get a notification right to your phone, tablet or watch. With all of the info you need, you can be the first to jump on hot properties.
 
Make the Deal
Get key property stats and the specific numbers you need to do an accurate valuation for your investment strategy. Share properties with your partners and contractor. Chat directly with the seller to get any questions answered. Whether you need to forecast ROI, NOI, or to run ARV or rent estimate calculations, you’ll have the information you need, at your fingertips. Then make an offer right from your mobile device. 
 
Lock it Up
The Trelly Team has worked through thousands of investment property closings – we’ve seen it all. We will partner with you to navigate the closing process and quickly close the deal.
 
With the deals, the data and connection to resources you need, Trelly is the digital marketplace for real estate investment.
